findings.label: Local import re in route helper
findings.detail: src/app/sdtm/routes.py imports re inside _require_domain to pattern-check the path domain. Cosmetic; prefer a module-level import or reuse of the contract pattern. Not blocking.

findings.label: Coverage test uses sentinel dict
findings.detail: tests/integration/test_phase5_output_coverage.py passes a sentinel dict (not real plan-head rows) to require_output_coverage. It validates the Specification-derived-set-minus-covered-keys computation but not the aligned_domain_plans resolution path feeding it; that path is covered by the deliverable-build integration tests. Not blocking.
